title: Computer Use

body.text: see the screen, move the mouse, click, and type like a person using a computer
— opening the door to automating programs with no API, like filling out old web forms or testing a UI automatically.

example: "Command: 'Open the company's legacy ERP, copy this month's sales into Google Sheets' — Claude does it through the real screen"

title: Use it safely

body.text: Because the AI can actually control the machine, you must
run it in a separate VM/sandbox, not your main machine, and limit what it can access
— important actions need a human confirmation point first, like before sending or paying.

example: "Set the rule: the AI can fill the form, but must stop for a person to check before clicking submit every time"
